title: Platform labeling and misinformation
summary: Platform labeling is an intervention for misinformation. It addresses the problem of low source awareness.

title: Inoculation intervention improves labeling
summary: The inoculation intervention builds on platform labeling and improves resilience to misleading claims. The challenge is transfer across communities.

title: Transparency mandate and algorithmic audit
summary: A transparency mandate adapts algorithmic audit to platform governance and compares it with community moderation.
